name: psir
description: The PSIR System is a digital application for managing Post-Sentence Investigation Reports in the Philippine correctional system. It provides a comprehensive 4-section form for capturing offender data including identifying information, criminal history, socio-economic background, and analysis. The form auto-saves every 30 seconds, and report numbers are automatically generated sequentially. Users can download completed reports as DOCX or PDF documents and manage all reports through a dashboard with search and filter capabilities. The application is built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and shadcn/ui, backed by a PostgreSQL database (Supabase) using Prisma ORM.
